figurative_meaning_en: To lie down stretching out arms and legs
example_sentences_in_bangla: ক্লান্ত হয়ে বিছানায় লম্বা হয়ে পড়লাম।
example_sentences_in_english: He stretched out on the sofa.
Tired, I lay down stretching on the bed.
note: This idiom is commonly used in everyday Bengali to describe reclining comfortably.
